source: KUDO release e-mails, v67.1 (9 Feb 2026) to v69.5 (26 Nov 2026). Greetings, sign-offs, links and client names removed; follow-ups merged; 15 July labelled v68.3 and 16 September v69.2 as confirmed by the Academy owner.

releases.title: KUDO 67.1
releases.text:
New features
* Usage Report Improvements (Phase 1 & Phase 2): Introduced a refreshed UI of “My Account” with two new sections:; Usage & Analytics; Overview: Account balance, Meeting metrics, Usage timeline; Meeting History: booked vs consumed hours; Attendees & Languages: Top and average languages, Average number of attendees; Value Analysis; ROI calculator; Reports are now downloadable in XLSX and PDF formats; Filtered by Human interpretation, KUDO AI, or both.; Improved accuracy and clarity of usage data; Enhanced data structure to support:; Tracking remaining vs. purchased hours; Plan end dates; Better usage control and forecasting; Super Admins can now view client plan details directly; The new Usage & Analysis dashboard is currently available only for client accounts with a single KUDO email associated to one server. For demo accounts and clients with multiple KUDO accounts or emails across multiple servers, the new dashboard will not be visible at this time.
* Automated KUDO AI Dashboard Email Alerts & Notifications: Automated email notifications sent to Sales and Clients; Provides timely visibility into key AI dashboard events, including:; Account inactivity; 50% plan usage reached; First meeting completed; Low balance alerts, etc.
* Download Transcripts on Teams: Clients can download meeting transcripts directly from Teams; Using the existing Download button now retrieves both recordings and transcripts
* Editable Description Field in Teams: Enables editing of the Description field for meetings scheduled from the Teams interface

Fixes
* Duplicate Alert on Captions Toggle: Resolved an issue causing duplicate alerts when captions were toggled; Captions Not Turning Off from Selector; Fixed an issue where captions remained enabled after being turned off via the selector

releases.title: KUDO 67.2
releases.text:
New features
* New Translation Languages Added: The platform now supports additional AI translation languages: Armenian, Assamese, Icelandic, Inuktitut, Kazakh, Lao, Macedonian, Malayalam, and Sinhala.
* Login Page UI Update: The login page interface has been updated to improve usability and visual consistency.
* Usage Report: Payment and usage reporting are now linked to Customer ID rather than individual accounts. This allows clients with multiple accounts on the same server to view consolidated usage reports.

Fixes
* Auto-Floor Setting Fix for Mobile Link & Widget: Resolved an issue where floor/original audio was automatically passed to language channels via the Mobile Link and iFrame Widget even when “Enable Auto-Floor” was disabled. The Auto-Floor setting now behaves correctly and respects the organizer’s configuration.
* Load and performance testing: Additional load and performance testing was conducted to support a large client deployment and ensure platform stability under higher usage conditions.

releases.title: KUDO 67.3
releases.text:
New features
* Download All Recordings & Transcripts as a ZIP folder (KCP, Teams): A new download option that allows clients to download all available meeting recordings and transcripts in a single click as a zip folder, instead of downloading each file individually. Available on KCP and Teams. On Teams, the existing download button now automatically downloads all files as a zip.
* Pre-selected Meeting Settings with Optional Default Saving (KCP): Pre-selected meeting settings are now available on the KCP scheduling page to streamline meeting creation and reduce repetitive setup. Clients can save their preferred configuration, allowing future meetings to be automatically pre-filled with these default settings. All fields remain editable before confirming the meeting.
* Multilingual Meeting Summaries for AI & Human meetings (KCP): Optional feature (feature flag under Super Admin). Recording must be enabled. Clients can download automatically generated summaries from the “Previous Meetings” tab (ZIP format, PDFs). Summaries include: key points, decisions, action items, attendees, overall summary. This feature is deployed in a GDPR-compliant manner. For customers with strict data residency requirements, EU-hosted infrastructure is used. Data is automatically deleted after 30 days. A feedback survey will be shared with selected clients testing this feature.
* Automatic Language Identification (KCP, Mobile app): Optional feature to automatically detect the spoken language from a predefined list (up to 10 speaking languages maximum). This follows the same implementation as on Teams. Accuracy may be affected in cases of rapid language switching. Within the session console, clients can select either “Automatic” detection or any specific language.

releases.title: KUDO 67.4
releases.text:
New features
* Account Reviewer Role (KCP): A new role, Account Reviewer, has been introduced to provide Sales teams with real-time visibility into client usage dashboards. This role enables better monitoring of activity, usage trends, and client engagement without requiring full administrative access.

Fixes
* Audio Manager Role in Participant Import (KCP): The Audio Manager role can now be assigned directly within the participant import Excel file. This aligns with how other roles are currently managed, making bulk participant setup more consistent and efficient.
* Updated Post-Meeting Links (KCP, Mobile): Post-meeting survey links have been updated across platforms:; AI post-meeting survey (KCP); Human post-meeting survey (KCP); AI post-meeting survey (Mobile link)
* Join Button Visibility (SSO Users): Resolved an issue where the Join button was not visible for pre-approved SSO users.
* Missing Session ID with Zoom Integration: Fixed an issue where meetings created on KUDO using the Zoom integration did not display a visible Session ID in Client/Admin accounts.

releases.title: KUDO 67.5
releases.text:
Fixes
* Interpreter audio setup improved: The platform now automatically selects the interpreter’s default OS microphone and speakers on join, aligning with the Participant experience and removing the need for manual configuration. Nudge & Handover issues resolved: Interpreters can now reliably use both features and switch between them without bot drops or interface failures. Message history download restored: The error preventing chat export (“Oops, something went wrong”) has been fixed, allowing users to successfully download meeting transcripts again. Headset selection stability fixed: Interpreter-selected microphones (e.g., USB headsets) now remain consistent and are no longer overridden when changing channels or system audio settings.

releases.title: KUDO 67.6
releases.text:
New features
* New bot support for Human interpretation meetings (same as in AI meetings): New bot support for Human Interpretation meetings. This refers to the same bot experience available in AI meetings on Microsoft Teams and Zoom, including video capture and screen sharing capabilities. The rollout is being managed incrementally through the “Recall AI support for human interpretation” feature flag. The bot joins the meeting as a participant and must be admitted in order to capture audio and produce translations.
* Bulk participant management introduced: Operators and hosts can now efficiently manage large meetings with the ability to select and remove multiple participants simultaneously.
* Profanity Filter added as a client-level feature flag: Profanity filtering implemented across all languages. This new option is enabled by default in all existing client accounts. It can be disabled under super admin.
* Recurring meeting email notifications redesigned: Notification delivery for recurring meetings has been streamlined to reduce email overload and improve user experience. The system now:; Suppresses bulk emails during recurring series creation; Sends one reminder email per occurrence, 24 hours before meeting start time; Immediately sends reminders for meetings created or updated within the 24-hour window
* Automatic summary disabled for new accounts: The automatic summary feature is now disabled by default for newly created accounts.

releases.title: KUDO 67.8
releases.text:
New features
* In-App Release Notifications: Users can now receive in-app notifications on KCP highlighting newly released features and improvements, helping them stay informed without relying solely on email communications. Available actions include:; Learn More; Mark as Unread; Remind Me Later; Delete. This enhancement provides a more engaging and accessible way for clients to stay up to date with platform updates.
* Demo Account Usage Overview: Super Admins and Account Reviewers can now view demo account usage directly from the client list. The new overview includes:; Number of meetings conducted per month; Number of minutes consumed per month. Access is available through the same workflow currently used to view the Client Usage Dashboard from the Account Reviewer and Super Admin roles.
* Speaker Diarization for Teams and Zoom Bot Integrations: Speaker diarization (speaker recognition) is now supported for Microsoft Teams and Zoom meetings using the new KUDO AI Translator bot. This enhancement improves transcript readability and meeting analysis by identifying and separating speakers throughout the conversation.
* VTT Transcripts for Floor Audio: VTT transcript generation is now available for floor audio in KCP and Teams meetings, including both:; Human Interpretation meetings; AI Translation meetings. This enhancement provides greater flexibility for transcript distribution, accessibility, and post-meeting review.

Fixes
* Bot Inactivity Notification for Teams and Zoom Meetings: A new informational message has been added when scheduling meetings on Microsoft Teams or Zoom to help users understand bot behavior during inactive sessions. The following notice is displayed: “The KUDO AI Translator bot will automatically disconnect if no participant is detected after 10 minutes. If the bot drops, simply click ‘Add Bot’ or ‘Restart Translation Service’ to reconnect and resume translation.”
* Improved French Voice Pronunciation: Resolved pronunciation issues affecting French voices, specifically related to liaison handling for words beginning with "L'". This improvement delivers more natural and accurate French speech output.
* Updated French (Canada) Male Voice: A new French (Canada) male voice has been deployed to production to provide a more natural and localized listening experience for Canadian French speakers. The previous voice delivered a more neutral French accent, while the new voice offers improved regional authenticity and pronunciation.

releases.title: KUDO 68.0
releases.text:
New features
* Automatic association of overusage meetings with the next subscription plan: To improve accuracy of the usage dashboard, meetings that occur after a subscription plan's allocated hours have been exhausted, or after a plan has expired, are now automatically associated with the client's next subscription plan. This enhancement ensures that usage reporting, remaining hour calculations, and customer-facing data remain accurate and consistent without requiring manual intervention. As part of the payment-plan correction process, the system now handles scenarios where:; A client continues using the platform after a plan has expired; Usage on a previous plan exceeds the purchased balance before the plan's original expiration date. In these cases, plan dates may be adjusted so completed meetings are counted against the correct plan period. You may notice a new line item such as:
* "Includes X rollover hours": Important: This does not mean KUDO now supports standard rollover of unused hours. Unused hours from a normally expired plan still do not automatically carry forward to a future plan. This enhancement only ensures that meeting usage is correctly attributed to the appropriate subscription period. The existing product and commercial policy regarding unused hours remains unchanged. This enhancement also enables the Usage Dashboard to be available for many more customer accounts. Additional accounts are currently being processed and will be ingested over the coming days. We will notify the team once the migration and correction process has been fully completed.

Fixes
* Session and account logos display reliably throughout events: Fixed an issue where uploaded account and session logos would intermittently stop displaying during customer sessions and events. In some cases, logos initially loaded correctly but later appeared as broken image placeholders. After this fix, uploaded logos now continue to display correctly and consistently throughout the session or event.
* Usage Dashboard navigation links fixed for Super Admin and Account Reviewer roles: Fixed an issue where links within the Usage Dashboard were not directing Super Admin and Account Reviewer users to the corresponding pages. After this fix, usage dashboard links now correctly navigate users to their respective destinations, improving account review and usage management workflows.

Fixes
* A fix for the WebLink issue where users were unable to click the JOIN button…: A fix for the WebLink issue where users were unable to click the JOIN button on mobile devices due to UI overlap when larger font sizes were enabled. This issue has now been resolved as part of the release.

releases.title: KUDO 68.3
releases.text:
New features
* Authenticated Mobile Link Viewer Access for Invite-protected Meetings: Invite-only meetings now support authenticated access through mobile link, allowing organizers to ensure that only authorized viewers can join from mobile devices. This capability is controlled through a Super Admin feature flag. Once enabled for a client account, organizers can:; Require authentication for viewers joining protected meetings via the mobile join flow; Import authorized viewers via CSV; Configure viewer authentication at the meeting level; Support ticket-based viewer account generation for specific clients; Suppress account invitation emails when required by the ticketing workflow. When viewer authentication is enabled, users accessing an invite-protected meeting through mobile link must sign in with an authorized account before they can access the meeting.
* Twi, Krio, and Ewe Added to KUDO Marketplace: Twi, Krio, and Ewe are now available as supported languages across both KUDO Marketplace and the KUDO Core Platform for human interpretation meetings. Please note that AI captions are not currently available for these languages.
* Install and Open App Links on Mobile Join Page: The mobile join page has been updated to replace the deprecated Firebase Dynamic Link with separate actions to install and open the KUDO mobile app. Users will now see two distinct options:; Install the app; Open the app

Fixes
* Profile Picture Updates Now Refresh Correctly: Fixed an issue where profile picture updates were not reflected for most user roles. Profile image changes now update correctly across the platform for all users.
* Summary Downloads Automatically Disabled After 30 Days: The Download Summary button is now automatically disabled once the 30-day retention period has expired. Previously, users could still attempt to download an expired summary and would receive an error. The interface now clearly reflects when summaries are no longer available for download.
* Resolved Meet Now Meeting: Fixed an issue where the KUDO mobile app incorrectly displayed the message “Your login period has expired. Please log in again." when users attempted to join or create Meet Now meetings. The app now maintains the authentication session correctly when a Meet Now meeting is created, preventing unnecessary re-login prompts.

releases.title: KUDO 68.4
releases.text:
Fixes
* Vietnamese and Hebrew Added to Glossary Support: Vietnamese and Hebrew are now supported in the KUDO Glossary. Organizers can create glossary entries for both languages to improve terminology consistency and recognition quality during AI meetings.
* Generic Viewer Authentication CSV Template: The Viewer Authentication CSV template has been updated to support all customers instead of using event-specific labels. The new template now uses the following generic fields:; First Name; Last Name; Email; Role; Password. This replaces the previous event-specific labels such as Distributor ID and removes the unused Tickets field.
* Azerbaijani AI Translation Restored: Resolved an issue affecting AI translation for Azerbaijani. Please note that a known limitation remains in captions-only meetings: when Azerbaijani is added as the source language, Azerbaijani translation is not available as a target language. This issue is limited to the captions-only workflow and is not reproducible in Speech-to-Speech meetings.
* Usage Dashboard Report Access Across Customer IDs: Fixed an issue where administrators could not access meeting reports when users under the same subscription plan belonged to different customer IDs. Meeting History in the Usage Dashboard now correctly includes meetings across different KUDO accounts associated with the same plan.
* Speaking Language Detection After Translation Restart: Resolved an issue where restarting AI translation in multilingual Speech-to-Speech meetings caused participant speech to continue being recognised using the previously selected source language. Speaking language detection is now correctly refreshed after translation restarts, ensuring participants are recognised using their current selected language.
* Interpreter Channel Publishing Reliability: Fixed a platform issue that could cause interpreter audio to be published to the wrong language channel during periods of high latency. Under certain conditions, rapid interpreter channel switching combined with temporary platform delays could result in audio being routed to an incorrect output channel. The publishing workflow has been improved to ensure channel selection remains synchronised and to prevent successful publication from being reported unless the correct audio stream has been established. Known limitation: There is an intermittent issue where passive interpreters may not receive the "Please turn on your microphone" prompt when they are expected to begin interpreting. This issue does not affect all sessions and is currently under investigation.
* AI Usage Statistics Page: Resolved an issue where Super Admins attempting to access AI Usage Statistics were incorrectly redirected to the Roles page. The AI Usage Statistics page now opens correctly.
* Microsoft Teams Operator Link: Fixed an issue affecting AI meetings created through Microsoft Teams integration where the Operator link incorrectly opened the Interpreter Console. Operator links now correctly launch the Operator interface.
* CTA Links on Mobile Applications: Resolved several broken call-to-action links within the mobile applications, ensuring users can successfully access the intended resources.
* Updated Mobile App Static Links: The mobile applications have been updated with new static links to ensure all informational pages function correctly. This includes fixes for:
* Other static information pages

releases.title: KUDO 68.5
releases.text:
Fixes
* Audio Publishing in Single-Participant Meetings: Fixed an issue where microphone audio was not published when only one participant was present in a meeting. Participant microphone audio is now available without requiring a second participant to join. Screen-share audio has also been fixed and is now available in single-participant meetings without requiring another participant to enter the session.
* Speech Recognition in Single-Language Captions-Only Meetings: Resolved an issue where the speech recognizer could fail to start in captions-only meetings configured with a single spoken language and no translation language. Speech recognition now works correctly in this configuration.
* Duplicate Captions with Speechmatics: Fixed an issue where captions could be duplicated for each speech segment when Engine 3.0 was enabled. Captions are now displayed correctly once per segment.
* Improved AI Segmentation for Lower Latency: Two segmentation layers have been combined to produce shorter, more responsive speech segments. This improvement is designed to reduce accumulated latency and provide a faster, smoother AI translation experience.
* Poll Statistics Export for All Poll Types: Poll Statistics Export is now supported across all poll types. Poll results can currently be downloaded individually from the Polls tab, making it easier for clients to access and analyze results after a meeting.
* New KUDO bot Enabled for All External Meetings: New KUDO bot is now enabled by default for all external meetings. Client-specific feature flags have been removed, simplifying the configuration and making Recall.ai functionality available to all customers using external meeting integrations.

releases.title: KUDO 68.6
releases.text:
New features
* Google Meet Support: KUDO now supports Google Meet as an external meeting platform, with a workflow similar to our existing Zoom integration. As part of this update, the previous “Zoom” switch on the scheduling page has been replaced with a new “External Meeting Platform” switch. Once enabled, organizers can select between Zoom and Google Meet. As with Zoom, the KUDO bot must be admitted into the Google Meet meeting when it requests to join. No additional Google Meet permissions or settings are required on the client side. The bot will request to join once the KUDO meeting is started.

Fixes
* Invalid Session ID for Finished Meetings: Fixed an issue where finished meetings could display an “Invalid Session ID” error. Completed meetings can now be accessed correctly.
* Scheduling Page: Language Selection and Automatic Language Detection Resolved several UI issues affecting language selection when scheduling meetings:; Clear all languages now works correctly for Spoken Languages in Human Interpretation meetings.; Automatic Language Detection now switches OFF automatically if all Speaker Languages are cleared.; Automatic Language Detection also switches OFF when languages are removed individually and fewer than two Speaker Languages remain.; The toggle can be enabled again normally once two or more Speaker Languages are selected.
* Participant Name Editing by Operators: Fixed an issue where operators could receive a 500 error when editing a participant’s name. The participant’s existing name is also now correctly pre-filled in the edit participant modal.
* Overlapping Translation Audio When Switching Languages: Fixed an issue that could cause audio from multiple translation languages to play simultaneously when participants switched quickly between languages. The previously selected audio stream is now correctly stopped when changing translation languages, preventing cross-talk and overlapping audio. The Audio Off option also correctly stops translation audio without requiring participants to refresh the page.

Known issues
* Double audio in Teams meetings
* Viewers appearing without a name in the lobby: We’ll keep you updated and let you know as soon as fixes for these two issues are released.

releases.title: KUDO 69.0
releases.text:
New features
* Enhancements (UI Changes): New homepage: the UI has been improved and the role selection screen has been removed. Roles must now be changed manually from the bottom left corner. Automatic role switching will be implemented shortly: at present, when a user joins a meeting, the client role is switched to participant automatically, which prevents them from seeing some of the tabs (e.g. “My Glossary”).; New joining/lobby page: the old joining and lobby pages have been merged into a single, more modern UI.; Meeting links: operator and participant links are now displayed in the UI after a meeting is created using an external meeting integration (Zoom, Google Meet or Microsoft Teams).; QR codes: the KUDO logo is now the default and only branding inside QR codes.; Engine 3.0: now enabled by default on all new accounts at creation.
* KUDO now supports Microsoft Teams as an external meeting platform: With a workflow similar to our existing Zoom and Google Meet integrations. As part of this update, once the “External Meeting Platform” switch is enabled, organisers can select between Microsoft Teams, Zoom and Google Meet. As with Zoom, the KUDO bot must be admitted into the Microsoft Teams meeting when it requests to join. No additional permissions or settings are required on the client side. The bot requests to join once the KUDO meeting is started, displays the QR code with the KUDO logo and posts an automatic message in the chat containing the mobile link. This new integration will not replace our native Teams integration.
* KUDO also now supports an ON24 integration: For now it is enabled from the backend only, so clients will not see it in the UI unless they request it: the integration needs to be tested thoroughly before it joins the other external meeting integrations.

releases.title: KUDO 69.1
releases.text:
Fixes
* First-Tour Walkthrough for the New Dashboard: A new first-time walkthrough has been added to the redesigned dashboard. The guided tour introduces users to the new experience and highlights key areas of the interface, making it easier to navigate the dashboard after the recent redesign.
* Simplified Advanced Settings for Meeting Integrations (Zoom, Google Meet, Teams): The scheduling experience has been streamlined to make configuration clearer and more relevant.; External Meeting has been renamed to Meeting Integration.; Advanced Settings have been simplified so that users only see options relevant to Meeting Integrations.
* QR Code on Teams native integration: A QR code is now displayed directly below the Mobile Link when scheduling a KUDO meeting on Teams through our native integration.
* Prevent Overlapping Floor and Interpreted Audio in Microsoft Teams: We have improved audio handling for participants listening to AI interpretation in Microsoft Teams. KUDO now detects when interpreted audio and the original Floor audio overlap and automatically mutes the Floor when necessary, preventing participants from hearing both audio streams simultaneously. This resolves the issue for participants using headsets, including Bluetooth headsets on Windows. Some overlap may still occur when participants listen through speakers without a headset.
* Preserve Acronym Capitalization in AI Captions: Speech-to-text casing is now preserved so that acronyms remain capitalized instead of being incorrectly converted to lowercase. This improves the presentation and consistency of terminology added to Do Not Translate and Word Priority.
* Improved Azure TTS Pronunciation in French: All words containing apostrophes are now processed and spoken correctly.
* Recurring Meeting Participant Management: Fixed an issue where adding a participant and applying the change to all instances of a recurring meeting could fail. Participant changes can now be correctly propagated across the recurring meeting series.
* Logo Visibility on the Join Page: Fixed an issue that could cause the client logo to be invisible on the Join Page.
* Correct Client Role When Joining: Fixed an issue where users with multiple account-level roles could join a meeting as an Account Reviewer or Super Admin instead of their available Client role. When a Client role is available, the user will now consistently join using that role.
* Voting-Only Meeting Default: Fixed an issue where Voting Only Meeting could incorrectly default to enabled when no client-specific configuration existed.
* Microsoft Teams Meeting Creation: Fixed an issue where meetings created directly through the Microsoft Teams app could incorrectly be identified as meetings created from KUDO.
* Technical Improvements: Several behind-the-scenes improvements have also been introduced to improve development and deployment efficiency:; Reduced KCP API deployment time; Parallelized KCP Web CI tests across available CPU cores, helping reduce test execution time

releases.title: KUDO 69.2
releases.text:
New features
* ON24 integration for human-interpreted meetings (Beta): KUDO now supports an ON24 integration for human-interpreted meetings. The integration is currently enabled from the backend and will not appear in the UI unless requested. It will remain in beta while we conduct further testing before making it available alongside our other external meeting integrations.

Fixes
* NVIDIA soft launch: NVIDIA is now available as an additional automatic speech recognition engine under a feature flag. This launch reflects KUDO’s approach to selecting the best technology for each component of our solution based on each client’s needs and use cases. If you would like to test the new engine, please reach out to me, and I can enable it for your account.
* “Meet Now” viewer link: Fixed an issue that caused viewer links to display a blank page.
* Operator name: The Operators tab now displays the operator’s name instead of the client or account name.
* Meeting History exports: PDF and XLSX exports now include the correct meetings, filters, and sorting for the client being reviewed.
* Meeting materials: Resolved upload errors, improved error messages, and corrected access for users with multiple roles.
* KUDO bot: Fixed an issue that incorrectly displayed the bot as dropped after a successful audio or video reconnection.

releases.title: KUDO 69.3
releases.text:
New features
* Glossary V2: The revamped glossary makes it easier to manage terminology and customize how KUDO AI recognizes and translates terms.; Five actions: Recognize, Translate As, Do Not Translate, Replace, and Block.; Flexible term creation: Add terms individually, import them in bulk, or optionally generate them with AI using pasted text or a prompt.; Default glossary: Set a default glossary for future meetings.; Automatic migration: Existing glossaries and saved default Do Not Translate and Word Priority terms are migrated automatically.; In-app guidance: A walkthrough and notification introduce the new glossary and explain how to get started.
* QR code access for Teams meetings: Added a QR code to Teams meetings using the native KUDO app, allowing participants to access the WebLink experience, as they already can with external meeting integrations.

Fixes
* Interpreter console/AI Assist availability: Fixed an issue where AI Assist remained available when captioning or WebLink access was disabled for interpreters. The AI Assist button is now disabled in these cases.
* Meeting statistics/captions-only language breakdown: Updated reports for KCP and Teams captions-only meetings to show user counts by target caption language instead of displaying only a single FLOOR total.
* Translation quality/ leading punctuation: Removed leading punctuation from caption segments before sending them for translation, improving translation quality and consistency.
* Join button activation on joining/lobby page: Fixed an issue where the Join button did not automatically become active when a meeting became available while a participant remained on the page.
* Repeated terms in captions: Fixed an issue that caused Do Not Translate and Word Priority terms to repeat in source captions and translations.
* UI consistency (buttons and fonts): Standardized button styling and fonts across the interface.
* WebLink “Jump to most recent” message: Fixed an issue where the “Jump to most recent” message appeared unexpectedly.
* Participant names/renaming consistency: Fixed an issue where a renamed participant’s name appeared differently to that participant and other viewers.
* COE/poll list and pagination: Fixed an issue where the poll list was limited to 50 entries and changing pages did not update the displayed rows.
* Session console/ meeting data updates: Fixed an issue where updated meeting titles and point-of-order information were not reflected in the session console after a refresh.

releases.title: KUDO 69.4
releases.text:
New features
* Segmenter extended to four more languages: Our in-house segmenter, which already supports English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, and Italian, now also supports Japanese, Chinese, Korean, and Russian. This reduces perceived latency, as translations now arrive in smaller chunks of text.
* Automated usage dashboard: Clients’ plan data is now uploaded and updated automatically every day, so all clients with an existing plan will see an up-to-date view of it soon.

Fixes
* Teams native integration - QR code and automatic message: The QR code and the automatic chat message sent by the bot are now displayed or sent only when Mobile link is enabled.
* Bot join time in AI meetings: The bot now joins a couple of minutes before the scheduled start time instead of 15 minutes before, unless preparation time is assigned or the meeting is started early.
* Role persistence after joining a meeting: Previously, if a user was logged in as a client in one browser tab and then joined a meeting as a participant in another tab of the same browser, their role in the first tab silently changed to participant too. Users then had to switch back to client manually or log out and back in. This has been fixed and applies to any other role combination.
* Force Close for Teams meetings: Added a Force Close option for Teams meetings through the native integration. It appears as a new switch rather than the usual checkbox found in KCP.
* Meeting logo removal: Clients who edit a scheduled meeting with a previously added logo can now remove it. After clicking Remove and confirming, the logo is deleted from the meeting.
* Glossary v2 - UI improvements: Terms can now be clicked and edited directly, without using the three-dot menu. When importing terms, users can add the same terms to compatible actions from the same pop-up. We also fixed several load failures, among other minor issues.
* Bulk actions in Users tab (COE accounts): Added multi-select and bulk delete to the Users tab for participants, viewers, operators, and all users.

Known issues
* The fix for the issue preventing Android users from performing actions in…: The fix for the issue preventing Android users from performing actions in meetings with a large number of participants is not included in this release. It will be released soon.

releases.title: KUDO 69.5
releases.text:
New features
* Background Effects in Live Meetings: Blur, preset backgrounds, and custom background uploads are now available. This feature is currently controlled through a feature flag, which Super Admins can enable.
* Participant counts in Usage & analytics > Meeting history exports: The Meeting History XLSX export now includes participant counts for each translation language.
* Webex integration: Webex is now supported as an external meeting integration and is available to all clients for both Human and AI meetings.

Fixes
* Hybrid meeting joining page: The On-site/Remote option no longer has a preselected value, so users must actively select the appropriate option.
* Fixed a silent-audio issue affecting language channels
